dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Ah! Something about this place feels familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: This campsite's layout is similar to the example provided in the first version of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Manual...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: You're amazing! How did you manage to remember all these little details...? I'm just in awe!
